europe_now.title: Estonia Blames Russia for Defense Arson
europe_now.summary: Estonian authorities have formally blamed Russia for an arson incident targeting a local defense company that supplies Ukraine. The cross-border sabotage highlights ongoing security concerns across the region.

sources.headline: Estonia blames Russia for arson at defence company supplying Ukraine

europe_now.title: Spain Bans Housing Evictions
europe_now.summary: Following widespread public protests sparked by the removal of an elderly resident, the Spanish government announced a comprehensive ban on evictions. The measure aims to address escalating housing pressures and civil unrest.

sources.headline: Spain announces ban on evictions after protests over 87-year-old woman's removal from flat

top_stories.title: Estonian Defense Site Arson
top_stories.summary: Estonia has attributed a recent arson attack on a key defense supplier to Russian actors. The targeted facility provides essential military equipment to support ongoing defense operations in Ukraine.

sources.headline: Estonia blames Russia for arson at defence company supplying Ukraine

top_stories.title: Spanish Eviction Ban
top_stories.summary: The Spanish government responded to massive public demonstrations by implementing a nationwide ban on housing evictions. These protests erupted following the controversial removal of an 87-year-old woman from her residence.

sources.headline: Spain announces ban on evictions after protests over 87-year-old woman's removal from flat
